The '''Corestrike Hotel''' was a [[Hotel/Legends|hotel]] located in the town of [[Corestrike]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Chrona/Legends|Chrona]]. It charged more than [[The Promenade (hotel)|The Promenade]], but was not as expensive as [[The Rising Moon]].<ref name="HNNA" />
